description: Incremental delta query for catalyst monitoring. Returns only new, date-shifted, resolved, rumor-updated, chatter-spike, or abnormal price/volume events for a ticker (or list of tickers) strictly after `since`. Returns an empty changes array on quiet days to minimize tokens.

minSeverity.description: Optional minimum severity filter: low | medium | high | critical.

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp or epoch ms cursor from the previous `nextCursor`. Only changes strictly after this timestamp are returned.

ticker.description: Single ticker symbol (e.g. NVDA, AAPL). Provide ticker or tickers.

tickers.description: Optional array of ticker symbols to query together.

types.description: Optional list of change types to include.

name: get_changes
title: Get Catalyst Changes Since
